display.purpose: Hero H1 only. 3rem, stepping to 3.75rem at lg. Capped at max-w-[13ch] with text-balance.

headline.purpose: Every Section H2. 1.875rem → 2.25rem at sm → 3rem at lg, balanced, in a max-w-[75ch] header block. Never overridden per section.

title.purpose: H3 blocks nested inside a section (rulebook, rule change). 1.5rem → 1.875rem at sm.

subtitle.purpose: H3 in the hairline-divided three-column groups (three jobs, three audiences).

lede.purpose: The single muted paragraph under a section heading. 1rem → 1.125rem at sm, max-w-[72ch]; the hero lede is 1.125rem/2 at max-w-[70ch].

body.purpose: Column copy at max-w-[42ch]; thesis prose at 1.125rem/2 and max-w-[65ch].

label.purpose: Field labels, table headers, badge text. Sentence case always; counter captions drop to 0.625rem.

mono-field.purpose: Shift IDs, rule IDs, clock times, rates, hours, confidence, mock frame titles, filenames. Always tabular-nums.

mono-log.purpose: The agent's live event stream. 0.6875rem → 0.8125rem at sm, in a fixed 4.7rem timestamp gutter.

counter.purpose: The two corrected-dollar totals. Space Grotesk digits with a smaller mono dollar sign — headline, not data. 1.25rem → 1.5rem in the hero log footer, 1.875rem in the audit stream.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: The surface's only easing curve — every keyframe, progress fill and connector transition.

motion.name: row-in
motion.purpose: 6px rise + fade for any newly arriving row, panel, message or ledger entry. The workhorse.

motion.name: flip-in
motion.purpose: scaleY(0.6) → 1 when a status badge changes state in place.

motion.name: delta-fly
motion.purpose: The corrected-dollar badge rises 48px and fades as it leaves the log toward the counters.

motion.name: caret-blink
motion.purpose: The 1px typing caret in a spreadsheet cell or message composer.

motion.name: pulse-dot
motion.purpose: The green live dot in a mock frame header; the only always-on animation.

motion.name: shimmer
motion.purpose: A green sweep across the source rail when the agent ingests from many places at once.

motion.name: count-up
motion.purpose: useCountUp easing for the two dollar counters and the memory stat.

motion.name: typewriter
motion.purpose: useTypewriter for spreadsheet cells (22 cps), the rule sentence (34 cps) and the chaser message (58 cps).

motion.name: sequence-pause
motion.purpose: useSequence banks the remaining phase time when the mock leaves the viewport and resumes on return — no jump cuts.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Two layers: the hook renders each mock fully populated in its end state; index.css then stills everything and disables smooth scrolling.

narrative.overview:
This is a white operations surface that behaves like a ledger someone is actually keeping. The page is not decorated: it is ruled. Zinc hairlines divide columns and rows, product mocks are white cards held by a single 1px ring, and every quantity — a shift ID, a timestamp, a rate, a dollar figure, a confidence percentage — is set in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures so columns of numbers line up the way they would in a payroll export. Space Grotesk carries headings and the two running dollar counters; Inter carries everything a person reads as a sentence.

One green (#22c55e) does all the accent work, and it is spent only on the agent's own activity: the live pulse dot, the primary CTA, the dollar delta flying out of the log, the connector segment lighting as data moves, the phrase the compiler just picked out of a rule. Status is a separate, deliberately quieter vocabulary — warning / success / info / destructive as 10% tints behind darkened text — so a queue full of states never competes with the one green thing the agent is doing right now. There are no shadows anywhere on this surface, no gradients, no glass; depth is a hairline and a tint step.

The page argues by demonstration rather than assertion, and the visual system serves that: nine animated product mocks, each a self-contained white frame labelled synthetic, each looping a short evidence-to-decision sequence and each declared role="img" so a screen reader gets one honest sentence instead of a moving table. Confirmed rejections: no dark mode on this surface, no eyebrows or kickers above headings, no section numbering, no card-grid "feature" layouts, no marketing photography, no shadows, no second accent hue.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, zinc hairlines, one green reserved for agent action
Mono for every number; prose never mono
Flat by construction — 1px rings and tint steps, zero box-shadow
Hairline-divided columns and real tables instead of card grids
Headings are full declarative sentences ending in a period, with no eyebrow above them
Nine looping product mocks, all non-interactive, all labelled synthetic

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: #22c55e marks agent action and nothing else. If a green element cannot be described as something the agent is doing or just did, it is the wrong colour.

rules.name: The Tinted Status Rule
rules.body: Status colour reaches the page as a ~10% tint behind its -foreground ink (bg-warning/10 text-warning-foreground), never as a saturated fill and never as saturated body text. The saturated value is allowed only on ≤14px icons and small link labels.

rules.name: The Zinc-Only Divider Rule
rules.body: Every border on the page is #e4e4e7. There is no coloured border, no coloured rule, and no border thicker than 1px.

rules.name: The Mono Ledger Rule
rules.body: Every timestamp, identifier, dollar amount, hour count and percentage is JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums. Prose is never mono; mono never carries a sentence longer than a field value.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: A section opens with its H2. No kicker, no eyebrow, no uppercase micro-label, no section number, no letter-spaced all-caps anywhere on the page.

rules.name: The Full-Sentence Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings are declarative sentences ending in a period, not noun phrases. A heading that could be a nav label is too short.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Related items sit in one bordered group divided by 1px rules, not in separate cards with gaps. A "three things" block is one border-y grid with border-l between columns.

rules.name: The Shed, Don't Scroll Rule
rules.body: Nothing on this page scrolls horizontally at 390px. A mock that cannot fit drops columns; a mock declared role="img" must never require a horizontal drag to be read.

rules.name: The One Container Rule
rules.body: Header, sections and footer all use max-w-7xl with px-5 sm:px-8 lg:px-10. No section invents its own gutter.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: This surface ships zero shadows. If something needs to separate from its ground, it gets a hairline or a tint step.

rules.name: The Two-Tone Rule
rules.body: Sections alternate white and bg-muted/55 down the page. Alternation is the only sectioning device; there is no coloured band.

rules.name: The Squared-Corner Bubble Rule
rules.body: A message bubble points at its sender by squaring exactly one corner. Never a tail, never an arrow.

rules.name: The One Card Rule
rules.body: A MockFrame is the only Card in its subtree. Panels inside a mock are rounded-lg border bg-background p-3 divs with a 0.75rem medium title — never a nested card, never a second ring.

rules.name: The Synthetic Label Rule
rules.body: Every mock carries the synthetic badge, and the footer repeats the disclosure. No number on this page is presented as real.

dos: Do reserve #22c55e for what the agent is doing right now — live dot, primary CTA, dollar delta, active rail segment, compiled-phrase highlight.
Do set every identifier, time, rate, hour, dollar and percentage in JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums.

Do render every section through Section so the heading spec (text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl, tracking -0.03em, balanced) and the max-w-7xl / px-5 sm:px-8 lg:px-10 / py-20 md:py-28 / gap-12 container stay identical page-wide.
Do divide grouped content with 1px Hairline Zinc rules — border-y around the group, border-l between columns from md, border-t when stacked.
Do put every product mock in a MockFrame with role="img", a full-sentence aria-label, and the synthetic badge.
Do drive every animation from useSequence and let it pause offscreen.
Do give reduced-motion users the final, fully populated frame of each mock.
Do shed table columns with hidden md:table-cell when space runs out.
Do write headings as complete declarative sentences ending in a period.
donts: Don't add a shadow. There are none on this surface, at rest or on hover.
Don't add an eyebrow, kicker, uppercase micro-label or section number above a heading.
Don't nest a Card inside a MockFrame, or ring an inner panel.
Don't turn a "three things" block into a card grid; it is a hairline-divided three-column group or a table.
Don't let a status hue appear as a saturated fill or as saturated body text — 10% tint plus the -foreground ink, with saturated values reserved for ≤14px icons and small link labels.
Don't use green as a decorative, structural or background colour, and don't introduce a second accent hue.
Don't make a mock interactive, focusable, or aria-live; a click target inside a role="img" is a bug.
Don't let any mock scroll horizontally at 390px.
Don't add a new keyframe or easing curve. The six keyframes and cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) cover the whole surface.
